name: min_parallel_index_scan_size
description: Sets the minimum estimated number of index pages (in 8kB units) that must be scanned before the query planner considers using a parallel index scan.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for large index scans
Increased query latency on multi-core systems
tuning_tips: Increase this value on systems with high per-worker overhead or slow interconnects to avoid inefficient small parallel scans; decrease it on large, fast multi-core systems with ample workers to encourage more parallelism for moderately sized index scans.
